note: American Samoa is an outlying possession of the United States (8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(29)); a person born there is a national, but not a citizen, of the United States at birth (8 U.S.C. 1408). Their nationality is the United States', whose naturalisation and loss rules are modelled; that an American Samoan becomes a citizen by naturalisation, and the national's narrower rights, aren't modelled.

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1408 Nationals but not citizens of the United States at birth
sources.said: Unless otherwise provided in section 1401 of this title, the following shall be nationals, but not citizens, of the United States at birth: (1) A person born in an outlying possession of the United States on or after the date of formal acquisition of such possession;

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1101 Definitions
sources.said: (29) The term "outlying possessions of the United States" means American Samoa and Swains Island. ... (38) The term "United States", except as otherwise specifically herein provided, when used in a geographical sense, means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
